metadata.title: How to Skip Conflicting File Names in Aligna | Screenshot Guide
metadata.description:
To skip files whose new names already exist, turn on Skip conflicting files in Aligna. Review the proposed names before using Apply.

Still-screen guide using a real Android emulator screenshot with repository demonstration filenames. The switch is already on in the example. No taps, actual conflict, rename result, or speed demonstration is shown.
